Net flows and all earnings/costs are period flows.\"],[null,null,\"Average AUM\",\"A simple opening/closing midpoint assumes activity is spread through each quarter. It does not reproduce daily AUM or fund-level fee accrual. Historical fees are allocated by midpoint weights and reconcile to reported H1 and FY.\"],[null,null,\"Management fees\",\"Model net management fees after distribution costs. Historical gross fees and distribution costs are shown separately as memo lines.\"],[null,null,\"Fee margin limitation\",\"The historical implied margin uses midpoint AUM and differs from the published margin. Base deliberately returns to the 2025 average 56bp despite H1 2026 average 52bp and 2025 exit run-rate 52bp. The assumed AUM investment return is therefore not multiplied by an incentive rate to generate fees. Earned carry sits within performance fees where applicable. Core metrics remove it; the model follows the reported core basis. No unsupported standalone carry or incentive-fee series is created.\"],[null,null,\"Fixed costs\",\"All fixed compensation belongs to the recurring management-fee business. Forecast fixed compensation is $274m / 4 and other fixed costs including D&A $215m / 4. No inflation or incremental cost savings are assumed. Other employment expense stays $7m / 4.\"],[null,null,\"Variable compensation\",\"Management participation is ($481m − $274m) / $1,077m. Performance/seed participation is $194m / ($281m + $38m). The latter attribution links fee costs to fees and seed costs to seed returns while preserving the company-reported total.\"],[null,null,\"Asset servicing\",\"Servicing scales with average total AUM at the 2025 calibrated blended rate. Management and seed financing remain $7m / 4 and $11m / 4. Management third-party profit share stays $2m / 4; performance share scales at $1m / $281m of fee revenue.\"],[null,null,\"Operating profit\",\"Model-defined core operating profit equals net revenue less core operating costs, including D&A and other employment costs.
